name: Blackline
summary: A black and white money app for one freelancer, with one orange accent and a live cash runway
about: A six-page personal money app for someone with uneven freelance income, set in stark black and white with a single orange accent and a light or dark theme. The main screen shows how many months your cash will last as a lit runway with a plane that slides to the month the money runs out, and what-if sliders change it live. Income, spending, fixed bills, accounts, transfers and a safety buffer all feed the runway, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the numbered sidebar: Runway, Money in, Money out, Accounts, Buffer or Settings
Drag the What if sliders or pick a scenario like Dry spell; the months, plane and chart update
Add expected work with how sure you are, and watch the runway stretch
Log payments and spending, or edit fixed bills; every change moves the runway
Move money between accounts and set how many months your safety buffer should cover
Press Ctrl+K to jump, download a CSV, and reset demo data in Settings
